fact_text: Fauji Cement reported FY25 EPS of about PKR 21.47, roughly flat against the prior year's EPS of about PKR 22.80.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 26 Sep 2025 | Cement Sector Results | FCCL EPS 5.43 | Pioneer Dividend | KAPCO | PPL' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Fauji Cement's FY25 sales were about PKR 33 billion, down from about PKR 35 billion a year earlier, as cement dispatches fell.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 26 Sep 2025 | Cement Sector Results | FCCL EPS 5.43 | Pioneer Dividend | KAPCO | PPL' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Fauji Cement's profit held up because cost cuts, including less grid power and cheaper non-imported coal, offset lower cement dispatches.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 26 Sep 2025 | Cement Sector Results | FCCL EPS 5.43 | Pioneer Dividend | KAPCO | PPL' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: About PKR 7.6 billion of a payment-company loan at Fauji Cement may convert into ordinary shares, which the analyst views as a strong balance-sheet step.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 26 Sep 2025 | Cement Sector Results | FCCL EPS 5.43 | Pioneer Dividend | KAPCO | PPL' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The analyst says Fauji Cement benefits from strong northern-zone retention prices and from its supply role to the Frontier Works Organization.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 26 Sep 2025 | Cement Sector Results | FCCL EPS 5.43 | Pioneer Dividend | KAPCO | PPL' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The analyst notes that cement makers running well below capacity can still earn profit when their efficiency is high, which he says has been Fauji Cement's habit.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 26 Sep 2025 | Cement Sector Results | FCCL EPS 5.43 | Pioneer Dividend | KAPCO | PPL' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The analyst had projected FY25 EPS of about PKR 31 to 32 for Fauji Cement, but lower cement dispatches from weak commercial and construction activity pulled the result down.

fact_text: The analyst says a cut in the policy rate could revive construction and infrastructure activity, which would lift cement dispatches and sector earnings.

fact_text: Northern-zone cement prices are cited at about PKR 1,400 to 1,500 per 50 kg bag, which the analyst says supports some valuation upside for the sector.

fact_text: The analyst values cement companies on the assumption that they run at about 60% capacity utilisation.
